page.title: Prayer schedule
page.lead: Prayer times, candle lighting and Shabbat end, the weekly Torah portion and holidays. The Jewish calendar and zmanim are calculated for the synagogue's coordinates.
page.servicesUnknown: Please call to check prayer times
page.computedNote: Candle lighting, Shabbat end and zmanim are calculated with hebcal (candles 18 minutes before sunset, Shabbat ends at nightfall).

holiday.inSynagogueText: Holiday services and events are in the schedule and the events calendar.

holiday.computed: Dates are calculated by the Jewish calendar (hebcal); a holiday begins the evening before.
